headline: Slovakia has filled its gas storage facilities to the volume needed for the heating season
summary: Slovakia has filled its gas storage facilities to the volume required for the heating season, Economy Minister Denisa Saková said. The report is dated 9 October 2026.
why: Gas storage levels indicate how well a country is insulated from winter supply shocks, which matters for European gas prices and energy-intensive industry.
